review.finding: useMaxWidth:false is configured only for flowchart, sequence, gantt, er, state, class; other diagram types keep mermaid's max-width:100% squeeze.
review.suggestion: Override with CSS [&_svg]:!max-w-none in natural mode so coverage does not depend on a per-type list.

review.finding: Theme is picked at render time and memoised on the content hash; a live light/dark toggle keeps the stale theme.
review.suggestion: Accept as known limitation or add the resolved theme to the memo key.

review.finding: Fit button has aria-pressed AND a flipping label (contradictory announcement) and renders during loading/error.
review.suggestion: Static label with aria-pressed only, and render only when an svg is present.

review.finding: APP_CONFIG is a hand-copied mirror of the component's options and already incomplete.
review.suggestion: Share a MERMAID_INIT_CONFIG constant or accept drift risk.

review.finding: Theme test leaks the wrapper node on assertion failure and relies on jsdom not resolving var(--color-surface).
review.suggestion: Clean up in try/finally or afterEach.
